title: PublicHealth AirPollutionClinicPanel

stats.done_summary: Completed daily panel analysis of PM2.5 vs respiratory clinic visits using Poisson GLM with HAC SEs, plus NB2 sensitivity. Generated descriptive tables, lag analyses, counterfactual policy scenarios, diagnostics, and 6 PNG figures. Wrote publication-style report to report/report.md (and copied to air_health_policy.md). Key code: code/air_health_policy_analysis.py and code/generate_report.py; outputs saved under outputs/ and report/images/.
